title: The Historical Record
subtitle: How the Order was built
text: The Incarnadine Fane was founded by Archon Erythravane — the first organized gathering of Hemomancers. The Sanguine Brotherhood arose during a time of war, when Harbingers began sharing blood pools to sustain each other in battle, which became the origin of the Bloodline covenant. The Crimson Lodge later documented the link between hemomancy and the mycelial network — and promptly sealed that knowledge, deciding it must be arrived at independently to be understood correctly. Those who found it without being told say the same thing: that it cannot be unlearned. A line does not end with its book. The Rite of Bloodline Recall calls an Unsigned Ancestral Ledger back out of a Harbinger's blood memory. The Brotherhood's old watch lives on in the Rite of the Covenant Vigil, where a sworn helper stands the whole Grand ordeal inside the caster's boundary and every survivor keeps ten minutes of resistance and regeneration. The Rite of the Eternal Covenant can be sworn only once, and it raises for good the most blood the caster's body can hold.
